translation.Description:
I'm a Frontend Developer with a degree in Software Engineering from Universidade Positivo, focused on building intuitive interfaces, sustainable code and well-structured architectures.

I work with the modern JavaScript ecosystem, including React, Next.js and Angular, using TypeScript, testing and component-driven development to create scalable, easy-to-maintain solutions.

I believe good software goes beyond working well: it should provide a good experience both for the people who use it and for those who build it. That's why I value code quality, collaboration and building products that actually solve problems.

translation.PortfolioDescription: The site you are browsing: a macOS-style desktop where each app tells part of my story. Contacts is who I am, Calendar is my career and education, Photos holds my projects, Music turns skills into songs and Mail is how to reach me. Built with React, Vite, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, with react-spring and use-gesture behind the windows, dock and lock screen. Available in English and Portuguese, in light and dark.
translation.BounceDescription: A study project to explore the limits and uses of Pixi.js: 2D rendering and interactive graphics running inside a React app. Built with React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Pixi.js.
translation.MovieDiscoverDescription: Movie Discover recommends films using the TMDB API, helping people find new titles based on their interests and preferences. Built with React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
translation.MinedSonarDescription: A game inspired by the classic Minesweeper, built to compare code with and without a design pattern. The repository has two branches: main, structured with Atomic Design, and without-pattern, the same game without it. Built with React, TypeScript, Zustand and Tailwind CSS.
translation.VideoMetadataDescription: A web app that extracts metadata from videos. Select or drag in several videos at once to get each one’s duration, resolution, aspect ratio and file size. Built with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
translation.BarbePortfolioDescription: A one-page portfolio website for a graphic designer, built with React, Vite, TanStack Router and Tailwind CSS, with Motion animations.
